verses.text: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.
lines: I will sing of loving kindness and justice.
To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.

verses.text: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
lines: I will be careful to live a blameless life.
When will you come to me?
I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

verses.text: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
lines: I will set no vile thing before my eyes.
I hate the deeds of faithless men.
They will not cling to me.

verses.text: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
lines: A perverse heart will be far from me.
I will have nothing to do with evil.

verses.text: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
lines: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor.
I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

verses.text: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
lines: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land,
that they may dwell with me.
He who walks in a perfect way,
he will serve me.

verses.text: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
lines: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house.
He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

verses.text: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.
lines: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land,
to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.
